body: Friends in SW Florida, I’ll be speaking at the Kindness Summit at Florida Gulf Coast University on Friday, May 15, at 4 pm. You can register here for just my session or for the whole event: https://www.k20kindness.com/   (Just fyi, this is my only public speaking engagement for the rest of 2026.)
